purpose: Evidence packet only. It does not authorise an unconditional passenger acceptance or a flight-space claim.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — lecture directe de la page officielle

facts.condition_scope: dog_plus_carrier > 8 kg and <= 75 kg
facts.finder_effect: For a 32 kg dog, show hold offered under conditions; do not turn booking availability into policy_unknown.
facts.quote: If your cat or dog weighs more than 8 kg/17.64 lb. and up to 75 kg/165.35 lb. with its carrier, it must travel in the hold.

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to pet plus container; do not positively clear a dog below 8 kg without carrier weight
facts.finder_effect: For a 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable.
facts.quote: The maximum permitted weight for a pet, combined with its container, is eight (8) kilos.

facts.condition_scope: larger cat or dog exceeding 8 kg including its container; route, aircraft, breed and connection exceptions apply
facts.finder_effect: For a 32 kg dog, show hold offered under conditions.
facts.quote: If you have a larger cat or dog which exceeds the eight (8) kilos weight limit (including its container), then it should only be transported in the baggage hold compartment of the aircraft.

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to pet including carrying bag
facts.finder_effect: For a 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable.
facts.quote: Maximum weight of the pet, including the carrying bag: 8 kg.

facts.condition_scope: snub-nosed dogs and cats are excluded from hold; capacity is limited to two pets per flight
facts.finder_effect: Show hold offered under conditions, not a promise of remaining capacity.
facts.quote: You may transport your pet in our cargo hold.
facts.locator: Can my pet travel in the luggage hold?

facts.condition_scope: recognised registered guide and assistance dogs are outside the pet-dog flow
facts.finder_effect: Show ordinary pet dogs as not transported, rather than unknown.
facts.quote: Animals are not allowed on our flights, apart from recognised registered guide and assistance dogs.

facts.condition_scope: same global pet exclusion
facts.finder_effect: Do not infer a cargo product without a separate easyJet source.
facts.quote: Animals are not allowed on our flights, apart from recognised registered guide and assistance dogs.

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to kennel including pet; cabin class and route restrictions also apply
facts.finder_effect: For a 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable.
facts.quote: Because they'll need to travel underneath the seat in front of you, the bag or kennel can weigh no more than 8 kg (17.6 lb), with your pet inside.

facts.condition_scope: pet plus kennel below 75 kg; fleet, connection, route and breed exclusions apply
facts.finder_effect: Show hold offered under conditions, not blanket acceptance.
facts.quote: You can bring up to 3 pets in the hold.

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to dog plus transport container
facts.finder_effect: For a 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable.
facts.quote: Only smaller dogs and cats weighing no more than 8 kg including their transport container may be transported under certain conditions as additional carry-on baggage in the passenger cabin.
facts.locator: What travel options are there for the different types of animals?

facts.condition_scope: dog plus container over 8 kg; route, weather and country restrictions apply
facts.finder_effect: Show hold offered under conditions for a large dog.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats weighing more than 8 kg including their transport container may be carried as excess baggage in the aircraft’s air-conditioned cargo hold under certain conditions.
facts.locator: What travel options are there for the different types of animals?

facts.condition_scope: global; assistance dogs are a distinct flow
facts.finder_effect: Keep the existing cited decision; do not extrapolate it to hold or cargo.
facts.quote: We don’t carry pets in the cabin on any route.
facts.locator: Travelling with pets → Travelling to and from the UK

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to pet plus carrier
facts.finder_effect: For a 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable.
facts.quote: Dogs, cats, ornamental fish, tortoises and birds may travel with you in the cabin if they do not exceed 8 kg in weight, including the pet carrier.

facts.condition_scope: cats and dogs; 45 kg pet plus carrier ceiling; breed, transit and booking exceptions apply
facts.finder_effect: Show hold offered under conditions.
facts.quote: The Iberia Group allow cats and dogs to travel in the hold.

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to pets plus carrier
facts.finder_effect: For a 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable.
facts.quote: Maximum total weight: 8 kg / 17 lbs (pets + carrier).
facts.locator: Transporting pets in the cabin → Weight and size

facts.condition_scope: 32 kg pet plus carrier on flights to, from, or with a stopover in France, United States, Hungary or Netherlands; 45 kg elsewhere; listed brachycephalic breeds excluded
facts.finder_effect: For a 32 kg dog on a France-related route, do not claim a positive result without the carrier weight.
facts.quote: Up to 32 kg / 70 lbs on flights to, from, or with a stopover in the US, Hungary, France and the Netherlands.

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to pet plus carrier
facts.finder_effect: For a 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable.
facts.quote: Pets traveling in the aircraft cabin cannot exceed a total of 8 kg, including their carrier.
facts.locator: Are there weight or size limits for my pet?

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling is 50 kg for carrier plus pet; carrier dimensions also limited
facts.finder_effect: Show hold offered under conditions for a 32 kg dog, subject to carrier weight and dimensions.
facts.quote: The total weight of the carrier and the pet together cannot exceed 50 kg.
facts.locator: Are there weight or size limits for my pet?

facts.condition_scope: the statement is limited to ordinary pet dogs; falcons and service dogs are distinct flows
facts.finder_effect: Ordinary pet dog follows a non-cabin path.
facts.quote: With effect from 11 January 2021, Qatar Airways will only accept service animal (SVAN) on board QR operated flights on regulated routes to assist passengers with a disability, with a maximum of 2 dogs per passenger.
facts.locator: Carriage of Live Animals → passenger-cabin policy

facts.condition_scope: domesticated dogs, cats and birds; local requirements, restricted breeds and route exceptions apply
facts.finder_effect: Show checked-baggage hold offered under conditions.
facts.quote: We accept domesticated dogs, cats and birds as checked baggage.
